title: Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts — Contractor Assignment and Contact Windows
content:
**Who may be dispatched.** A contractor is dispatched only on a service request whose Homeowner Service Contract status is active, as shown on the contract record.

**Choosing the contractor.** The request is assigned to a network contractor whose trade matches the request's trade and whose service ZIP codes include the ZIP code of the covered property. Within that set:

1. preferred contractors are chosen before standard ones;
2. suspended contractors are never assigned;
3. an emergency request is assigned only to a contractor offering emergency service;
4. among equally ranked eligible contractors, the one whose service contractor reference sorts first alphabetically is assigned.

**Contact window.** The assigned contractor must contact the customer within the tier's routine contact window (hours) for a routine request, or the tier's emergency contact window (hours) for an emergency request, measured from the dispatch.

**Missed contact and out-of-network authorization.** When the assigned contractor misses the contact window, the request is re-dispatched to the next eligible contractor with the dispatch reason "re-dispatch after a missed contact window". When no eligible network contractor exists for the trade and ZIP code, or two consecutive assigned contractors miss the contact window, Bridgewell pre-authorizes the customer to use a licensed contractor of their choosing by recording an assignment with the dispatch reason "out-of-network authorized" and no contractor reference.

**Second opinions and recalls.** A second-opinion request is assigned to an eligible contractor other than the one that made the initial diagnosis. A recall request is assigned to the contractor that performed the original work unless that contractor is now suspended, in which case it is assigned as an initial request.

**Numbering.** Each assignment on a request carries the next dispatch sequence number, starting at 1.

### Assignment outcomes (hypothetical cases)

| Situation | Outcome under these rules |
|---|---|
| Two preferred plumbing contractors cover the ZIP code, references B-204 and A-310 | A-310 is assigned (sorts first) |
| First contractor misses the window | re-dispatch to the next eligible contractor, sequence 2 |
| Second consecutive contractor also misses the window | out-of-network authorization recorded, sequence 3 |
| No eligible network contractor for the trade and ZIP code | out-of-network authorization recorded |
| Recall, original contractor now suspended | assigned as an initial request |
